quality_notes: EDF content is git-annexed and absent from the local clone; it is fetched from the public bucket and verified against the SHA256 in each annex key.
Annotation onsets are relative to the run start; all modality files of a run share that origin (EDF+C, 1 s records, record counts equal recordingDuration).

Accelerometer files are labelled g but use per-file scales: median |acc| (gravity) is ~1/2 or ~1/6 in valid runs; in others it is pinned at 32.768 or zero. Valid runs are rescaled to g by their own gravity estimate; the rest are excluded (ACC_SCALE_VALID). Gyroscope channels are labelled 'g', their unit is undocumented and their scale differs between runs, so only scale-invariant gyro features are used.
EMG is a single left-deltoid channel at 256 Hz with strong low-frequency (ECG/motion) content.
No age, centre or medication metadata is distributed; only sex.
Seizure annotations come from vEEG review; FBTCS onset is the focal onset, so the convulsive phase starts some time after the annotated onset.
